gripper_close.description: Gripper close command issued but closed-position feedback not confirmed in time.

H_GRIP_SENSOR_MISALIGNED.label: Closed-position sensor misaligned or out of range

H_AIR_PRESSURE_LOW.label: Gripper air supply pressure too low (slow or weak close)

H_GRIP_VALVE_FAULT.label: Gripper solenoid valve or output not switching

H_GRIP_SENSOR_CABLE.label: Closed-position sensor cable or connector fault

case_missing.description: Sequence waiting for a case at the pick position that was not detected.

H_UPSTREAM_STARVED.label: No cases arriving from the upstream line (cell starved)

H_CONVEYOR_DRIVE_FAULT.label: Infeed conveyor drive stopped or faulted

H_CASE_JAM.label: Case jammed on the infeed before the pick position

place_permissive.description: Place step blocked because a safety permissive at the pallet station is false.

H_LC_OBSTRUCTED.label: Object partially obstructing light curtain LC2

H_SAFETY_RESET_PENDING.label: Light curtain clear but safety relay latched awaiting manual reset

T_GRIP_IO_CHECK.name: Gripper IO and valve coil check
T_GRIP_IO_CHECK.description: Reads close command output Q4.0, valve Y4 coil current, and open/closed feedback inputs I2.0/I2.1.

T_AIR_PRESSURE.name: Gripper manifold air pressure
T_AIR_PRESSURE.description: Reads the analog pressure transducer at the gripper valve manifold. Minimum for rated close time is 5.5 bar.

T_GRIP_SENSOR_DIAG.name: Closed-position sensor IO-Link diagnostics
T_GRIP_SENSOR_DIAG.description: Reads measured target distance and device status from the IO-Link inductive sensor B21 (switching distance 2.0 mm).

T_GRIP_MANUAL_CYCLE.name: Gripper open/close cycle in maintenance mode
T_GRIP_MANUAL_CYCLE.description: Commands one open/close cycle and times the feedback transitions. Moves equipment.

T_CONVEYOR_DRIVE.name: Infeed conveyor drive status
T_CONVEYOR_DRIVE.description: Reads the infeed VFD run status, speed feedback, and motor load.

T_UPSTREAM_FLOW.name: Upstream case flow
T_UPSTREAM_FLOW.description: Counts cases seen by the infeed entry sensor B10 over the last 5 minutes.

T_CASE_TRACKING.name: Case tracking between infeed entry and pick
T_CASE_TRACKING.description: Compares the last case entry time with the expected 9 s transit time to the pick position.

T_PICK_EYE_DIAG.name: Pick photo-eye signal diagnostics
T_PICK_EYE_DIAG.description: Reads received-light margin and contamination flag from photo-eye B12 over IO-Link.

T_SAFETY_CIRCUIT.name: Safety circuit status (read-only)
T_SAFETY_CIRCUIT.description: Reads LC2 OSSD outputs and safety relay K20 channel and latch state. Does not reset anything.

T_LC_BEAM_DIAG.name: Light curtain beam diagnostics
T_LC_BEAM_DIAG.description: Reads per-beam signal strength and device fault code from LC2 diagnostics.

prohibited_actions.restart_cell: Restarting the cell can move the robot and conveyor with personnel nearby. Only an authorized operator may restart after the cause is cleared.
prohibited_actions.reset_alarm: Alarm acknowledgement and reset is performed by an authorized operator at the HMI after the cause is cleared.
prohibited_actions.reset_safety_circuit: Safety circuits are reset only locally by an authorized person after physically verifying the zone is clear.
prohibited_actions.bypass_interlock: Interlocks and safety devices must never be bypassed or muted by software.
prohibited_actions.force_output: Forcing PLC outputs is prohibited outside a supervised maintenance procedure.
prohibited_actions.move_robot: Robot motion commands are outside ARIA's permitted tool set.
prohibited_actions.change_parameter: Changing timeouts or machine parameters requires engineering change approval.
